inserts.name: Pack Mule
inserts.blurb: A stubborn animal that carries what you cannot.
inserts.description: An insert is a half-sheet: its own sections and moves, added to the sheet when you take it. Treat the mule as a follower.

options.label: Ornery
options.text: It bites. Mark a box each time it does.

moves.name: Stubborn
moves.trigger: When you try to make the mule do something it would rather not...

outcomes.7-9: It does it, slowly and loudly.
outcomes.6-: It does not, and everyone hears about it.
